receipts.terminal: final-receipts/terminal.json records exit status, last/failing stage, source commit and pre/post source manifest SHA256, lock hash observations, per-stage argv/status/log SHA256, package HEADs, Lean commit/version, Slurm job/step/node, cgroup, CPU affinity, and separate expected outer-guard paths/status/child-drain requirement.
